svg.title: AGBOT robot wiring diagram (original code)
svg.desc: Pin-level wiring map of the AGBOT robot from the original Arduino Mega and Uno programs: sensors and status outputs on the Mega, a 3-wire handshake to the Uno, wheel motor PWM/DIR pins, and arm motor shield pins.
svg.text: Arduino Mega (master) and Arduino Uno (arm controller) · only I/O defined in the programs is shown
driver type not given in code
Arm 1 camera window x=80–90 (check commented out)
Drive motor setup only when ENABLE_DRIVING = true
Arm 2: extend 1000 ms · pause 100 ms · retract 1000 ms
Not specified in the code, so not drawn: battery and motor power distribution, device VCC/GND leads, Pixy2 interface pins, exact LCD header wiring.
